objective: Authorize one narrow leo_sim_v2 E0 run on the measurement-proxy multi-OD burst profile so the formal receipt and V2 analysis chain can be exercised without claiming algorithm effects.
context: This is a single non-learning engineering-to-formal bridge run.
It tests exact config/trace/code/deployment binding, natural completion, conservation, data ISL forwarding and control-plane delivery.
It does not claim congestion superiority, Q0 optimality, calibrated operator traffic, or paper results.
deliverables: One formal V2 receipt suitable for the analysis-chain fixture
cannot_claim: This run does not prove algorithm superiority, Q0 optimality, long-run statistics, or paper-ready congestion conclusions.
acceptance: The request, compiled manifest, resolved config and analysis request bind one exact leo_sim_v2 run.
The clean deployed main SHA and execution-chain hashes are checked by authorization and remote launch.
The run ends naturally with conservation true, at least one delivery, at least one multi-satellite delivery, positive data ISL forwarding and delivered control traffic.
